injuries.name: Mike Matheson
injuries.note: Matheson missed six straight games before returning to the lineup against Boston on Thursday. However, he was back on the shelf for Saturday's 4-1 loss to Colorado and will need more time to recover from his lingering injury. The 32-year-old defenseman has one goal, four assists, 16 shots on net, 16 blocked shots and five hits in nine appearances this season. With Matheson out, Adam Engstrom and David Reinbacher could compete for playing time.

injuries.name: Josh Anderson
injuries.note: The Canadiens moved Anderson to the injured reserve list Sunday after he logged a season-low 10:46 of ice time in Saturday's 4-1 loss to Colorado. He has contributed eight goals, 12 points, 35 shots on net and 42 hits in 19 appearances this season. With Anderson and Chris Kreider (lower body) dealing with long-term injuries, Florian Xhekaj and Owen Beck could see regular minutes in Montreal's bottom-six forward group.

injuries.name: Chris Kreider
injuries.note: ir

injuries.name: Ivan Demidov
injuries.note: Demidov has been on injured reserve since Oct. 6, and he initially received a return timetable of 2-4 weeks. He's now at the end of that estimate, and while it's encouraging to see him skating on his own, he's still in a walking boot, per Eric Engels of Sportsnet. Demidov appears likely to miss at least a few more games, but another step in his recovery will occur once he's officially cleared to practice with his teammates.

injuries.name: Sam Montembeault
injuries.note: Montembeault will miss his 11th straight game against Pittsburgh on Saturday, but he participated in the morning skate and appears to be working his way toward a return. He hasn't logged any playing time in the 2026-27 season, and it will be difficult for him to get starts once he's healthy behind Jacob Fowler and Jakub Dobes.

injuries.name: Sean Durzi
injuries.note: Durzi hasn't been in the lineup since Oct. 26 and remains on injured reserve. Marc Del Gaizo was assigned to AHL Hartford following Monday's 3-1 over the Canadiens, leaving the Rangers with six healthy defensemen, so all signs are pointing to Durzi being ready for the team's next game.

injuries.name: Alberts Smits
injuries.note: ir

injuries.name: Igor Shesterkin
injuries.note: Shesterkin was hurt during Friday's game against the Capitals when his right leg got jammed into the post while returning to the crease on a scrambled play, and the Rangers ruled him out for the season a day later. He was placed on injured reserve Sunday, and the team has now provided some clarification on the exact nature of his injury. Dylan Garand is slated to serve as the Rangers' No. 1 option in the crease until Joonas Korpisalo (lower body) is back in action.

injuries.name: Joe Veleno
injuries.note: Veleno has already missed the last two games, and he is slated to miss at least three more months. He hasn't earned a point in four appearances this season, but he has contributed two shots on goal, five blocked shots and seven hits.
